summary: Verified the new Bank Reconciliation feature end-to-end (backend + frontend) plus the spec'd regressions. Backend: 7 new pytest cases for /api/bank/* added in /app/backend/tests/test_bank_reconcile.py — all 7 pass. Full backend suite 39/41 passing (2 are pytest-xdist ordering skips of the dependent history tests when classes split across workers; they pass cleanly with -n 0). Frontend: every spec'd selector (nav-bank, bank-page, bank-upload-input, bank-result, bank-balance-check, bank-txn-credit-<i>, bank-txn-debit-<i>, bank-history-<id>, bank-delete-<id>) verified live against the preview URL with the sample Heartland PDF; reconcile numbers, match labels, Review badges, history reload and delete all behave per spec. Regressions on Dashboard (Net trend line), P&L Statement, Vendors multi-category, and Expenses search all pass.

GET /api/bank/statements -> list contains the newly reconciled statement (id present).
GET /api/bank/statements/{sid} -> returns full doc with meta, summary, credits, withdrawals (no pdf_base64, no _id).

action_items: None blocking. Feature is fully verified.

(Optional) Consider adding @pytest.mark.dependency or scope='session' fixture so the Bank history tests don't get split across pytest-xdist workers — currently they skip in parallel mode but pass with -n 0.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:1064-1174 parse_bank_statement + reconcile_statement: deterministic pdfplumber parser + amount match with $0.50 tolerance and used-id sets to prevent double-matching. Numbers match spec exactly on the sample PDF. Good defensive try/except around PDF read returning HTTP 400.
/app/backend/server.py:1184 'no transactions' branch returns 422 — clean negative-case handling. Empty PDF actually hits the 400 path because pdfplumber raises, which is acceptable.

/app/backend/server.py:1196 Each reconcile call inserts a fresh bank_statements doc (intentional per agent-to-agent note). No de-dup by (period_start, period_end, ending_balance). Fine for now; may want a UI confirm before re-upload.
/app/backend/server.py:1213,1221 ObjectId lookups: no try/except around ObjectId(sid) — a malformed sid would raise InvalidId -> 500. Low priority since UI only passes server-generated ids.

/app/frontend/src/pages/BankReconcile.jsx (~183 lines, well under file-size threshold) uses one cohesive component with two small render helpers (TxnTable, Card). All required data-testid hooks present. Hidden file input pattern is fine (set_input_files works server-side; for manual users, the parent label is clickable).
BankReconcile.jsx:43 uses native window.confirm for delete — acceptable for admin-only feature; could be moved to a Radix AlertDialog for consistency with rest of app.
AppShell nav-bank present in sidebar; mobile m-nav-bank derived from template literal — no separate change needed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new + 39/41 full suite; 2 skips are xdist-related, all pass with -n 0)

seed_data_creation: Each reconcile call inserts a bank_statements doc. The frontend run + backend test together added a handful of duplicates; the frontend test deleted one via the UI, the backend test deleted the one it created. Existing history accumulates and is expected per the agent note.
